description: This file defines internal function prototypes related to HTTP authentication, including digest and basic authentication handling, nonce management, and request parsing, specific to an internal API within a larger HTTP server implementation.

methods.name: HttpAuthoCalcDigResponse
methods.description: Calculates the response digest for HTTP authentication based on provided parameters.

methods.name: HttpAuthoCalcDigestHA1
methods.description: Calculates the HA1 hash component used in Digest authentication.

methods.name: HttpAuthoCalcDigestHA2
methods.description: Calculates the HA2 hash component used in Digest authentication.

methods.name: HttpAuthoGetRequestHostUri
methods.description: Extracts host name, port, and URI path from the HTTP request.

methods.name: HttpAuthoGetAuthInfo
methods.description: Retrieves authentication information from the request context.

methods.name: HttpAuthoGetDigestAuthInfo
methods.description: Parses digest authentication data from the request.

methods.name: HttpAuthoGenBasicChallenge
methods.description: Generates a Basic authentication challenge string.

methods.name: HttpAuthoGenDigestChallenge
methods.description: Generates a Digest authentication challenge string with specified parameters.

methods.name: HttpAuthoGenBasicResponse
methods.description: Creates a Basic authentication response header.

methods.name: HttpAuthoGenDigestResponse
methods.description: Creates a Digest authentication response header.

methods.name: HttpAuthoGenResponse
methods.description: Generates an authentication response based on the provided header.

methods.name: HttpAuthoVerify
methods.description: Verifies the authentication information received in a request against expected credentials.

methods.name: HttpAuthoEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables HTTP authentication functionality.

methods.name: HttpAuthoIsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if HTTP authentication is enabled.

methods.name: HttpAuthoGetCryptoObject
methods.description: Retrieves the cryptographic context or object used in authentication.
